entries.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Be still, and know that I am God.
What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
A merry heart doeth good like a medicine.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee.
They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength.
Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God.
I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
Do justly, and love mercy, and walk humbly with thy God.
Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
Seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
He that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you.
If God be for us, who can be against us?
Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer.
Let all your things be done with charity.
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
Let us not be weary in well doing.
Be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication let your requests be made known unto God.
The peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds.
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
My God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
Rejoice evermore.
Pray without ceasing.
In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
The Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God.
Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you.
Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
God is love.
We love him, because he first loved us.
I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health.
